newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said European Investment Bank (EIB) President Brian Unwin would hold a news conference on the EIB's annual report at 1000/0900 GMT on Thursday at the Eurovillage Hotel.

Van der Pas said the Commission had agreed Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard's intention to review the 90/220/EEC directive on food labeling in the framework of genetically modified organisms. Because the review might not happen before June, the Commission has proposed to issue guidelines to allow Member States to act beforehand, he said. Van der Pas said those guidelines should be ready for mid-March.
In answer to a question spokesman Peter Jorgensen said those guidelines would not legally bind member states.

In reaction to reports on Italy and European Monetary Union, spokesman Patrick Child said all member states had authority to take part in EMU. He also said that article 109K of the Treaty allowed a re-evaluation of a "pre-in" member state's accession to EMU at least every two years or at the member state's request.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/85: Television without frontiers and major (sports) events: Commission communication.
- IP/97/86: The Commission requires a Danish shipyard to repay the excess aid granted in relation to five vessels.
- IP/97/87: State aid: the Commission takes three positive decisions in German cases.
- IP/97/88: The Commission approves the prolongation of two Finnish aid schemes for shipbuilding.
- IP/97/89: The Commission approves the prolongation of the Dutch subsidy regulation for the new building of seagoing ships until 31 December 1996.
- IP/97/90: The Commission approves rescue aid to Actual Maschinenbau AG (Austria).
- IP/97/91: The Commission approves transport aid in favour of Swedish nordic regions.
- IP/97/92: The Commission opens procedure against restructuring aid in favour of Stahl- und Hartgusswerke Boesdorf AG.
- IP/97/93: The Commission opens procedure against road transport aid in Friui-Venezia Giulia region.
- Memo/97/13: Facts about the 'Social Chapter'.
- Eurostat news release No 12/97: Luxembourg ahead of USA & Japan.
- Eurostat - Economy and Finance: Quarterly accounts - second quarter 1996.
- Eurotransit conference on "A new transit system for Europe" - Feb 6-7 - Final Programme.
- ME97/5.2: Midday Express.
